text:
toni: FYI onboarding Candela's adapter (candela-lora-1.0). Quick smoke found weird negative sign flips and thousand-sep drops when running the int4 quant path on their invoice set. anyone available to eyeball?

yael: can you paste one failing pair? short is fine.

toni: pasted (redacted):

```
input: "Balance due: -$4,200.00"
expected: "Balance due: -$4,200.00"
model (fp16): "Balance due: -$4,200.00"
model (int4): "Balance due: 4,200"  <-- lost minus and cents
```

yael: wow that loses the minus and the cents. Is the tokenizer mapping the minus sign to a grafted token?

toni: merge config uses tokenizer: candela-graft-v3 + base-en. We added a few currency tokens.

yael: two quick checks: 1) run with graft disabled (`--tokenizer=base-only`) to see if graft is the culprit; 2) run `--quant-calibration=skip` vs `--quant-calibration=full` to see calibration effect.

eval-bot: running evalpack (200 samples) with variants: base-only/int4, grafted/int4, grafted/int8. Will post results.

toni: also curious whether postprocessing (currency formatter) ran in runtime. int4 runtime sometimes skips the postproc hook if OOM fallback happens.

yael: good point. Add `--force-postproc` on the grafted run.

eval-bot: results: grafted+int4: 16/200 sign/cents errors. base-only+int4: 1/200. grafted+int8: 0/200. grafted+int4+force-postproc: 12/200. latency int4 ~ -20% vs fp16. Artifacts: s3://redwood-eval/candela/candela-lora-1.0/1698765432/

toni: token dump from a failing case:
```
# tokens (grafted): [12, 4500, 9001, 77, 310, 999]
# detok pre-proc: "Balance due: - 4 200 . 0 0"
# postproc -> "-4,200.00"
# int4 output -> "4,200"
```

yael: looks like minus token became separated and then scoring dropped it. Could be beam scoring or a tokenizer merge that created a longer token sequence with lower total logit for the minus + cents.

toni: repro: only reproducible when grafted tokens present and quant=int4. fp16 and int8 clean.

yael: mitigation options: 1) bias known punctuation/numeric tokens in decode logits to prefer keeping them when a numeric span is detected; 2) add a small penalty for deleting leading punctuation in number spans; 3) temporarily pin Candela to int8 until we run a quant-calibration sweep targeting grafted tokens.

toni: I'll open a ticket and pin canary to int8 for now. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-1301

eval-bot: created artifact and attached token dumps and eval CSV. CI link: https://ci.internal.redwood/job/9213

ops-bot: canary deployment for candela-lora-1.0 scheduled on stack-3 at 1698765455.

yael: also propose adding a lightweight unit test in the graft pipeline that runs a 50-sample numeric-format check with int4 to catch regressions pre-merge.

toni: adding test now. will update when green. :thumbsup:

yael: thanks — if calibration sweep needs GPUs ping infra.

toni: will do, closing thread after test lands.
